title: NFT floor price prediction marketplace
tagline: An NFT prediction marketplace that allows everybody to join the NFT movement to predict the floor price of NFT collections in a period of time.
description:
This project is designed for anybody have crypto to predict each NFT collection's floor price and win the prizes if they voted the right answer (up/down) after a fixed period of time                                                                             
                         

.
how_its_made:
This project is used the Covalent API to get NFT metadata, and used the Graph as the blockchain indexing solution so the UI can use a dedicated subgraph to query on-chain data.                                                      
                                                         
 .
